name: AI Recipe: Agent Persona (Known Figure)
description: Claude researches one well-known real person or established fictional character and writes a debate-ready, second-person persona card any model can adopt, rotating across ten subcategories, with an illustrated portrait cover and a square chat avatar when an image key is set.

parameters.label: ai-automation-recipes clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your local clone of ai-automation-tools/ai-automation-recipes.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.help: Root folder for all recipe output. Each recipe writes into its own collection under it.

parameters.label: Claude model
parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Cover image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips the cover and the avatar; the card still publishes. Engines may decline a real person's likeness.

author: ai-automation-tools
